title: Ultra Food
description: Adds a variety of foods that you wont except on minecraft!
body:
Are you mining and you forgot to bring food?

Are in the nether and you forgot to bring food?
 
This mode solves these problems by adding simple crafting recipes to you can make food anywhere!

 ----------------------------------------------------------------
#  Features
This mod adds a variety of random and not so tasty food. The reason for that is that the foods are just for you to barely survive and not to eat longterm.

For example, this are the _Netherack Food_ and _Diamond Soup_:

![Nether Food](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9c2ebeeab58ab6e87d60018a2971c24f2e1395a.png)  ![Diamond Soup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00f276bc42f9c402368e714c3b711da054a88f3c.png)

You are stack on the nether? No problem! Take Netherrack Food!

Are you SUPER rich? Make diamond soup with the _Stone Bowl_!

And of course there is SO MUCH more like this!

---------------------------------------------------------

Please try my other old mods [Ultra Guns](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultra-guns) & [Mine The World](https://modrinth.com/mod/mine-the-world).
